title: Unifies the billing cycle anchor format across Subscriptions and Invoices
summary: Unifies how updates to a subscription’s billing cycle anchor are formatted when updating Subscriptions, resuming Subscriptions, and creating Preview Invoices. The billing_cycle_anchor field now uses a consistent object format with a type field, replacing the previous string, enum, and timestamp formats. The billing_cycle_anchor field now requires an object with a type field instead of a string value (for example, {type: 'now'}). When creating a preview invoice, the subscription_details.billing_cycle_anchor field requires an object with type and timestamp fields.
migrationNotes: Previously, you could pass a string value when updating a subscription’s billing cycle anchor. Instead, set billing_cycle_anchor to an object with an equivalent type parameter.
When creating a preview invoice for a new subscription whose billing cycle anchor is a future timestamp, replace 1234567890 with {type: 'timestamp', timestamp: 1234567890}.
